description: Reviewed disposition rules for complete HIP 7.2.1 declarations not present in the managed owner manifest.

rules.name: deferred-external-interop
rules.reason: Requires an external graphics or interprocess resource capability that is not part of the current cloud contract.

rules.name: deferred-callback-and-profiler
rules.reason: Callback or profiler ownership needs a dedicated lifetime and capability workload before managed exposure.

rules.name: deferred-deprecated
rules.reason: Deprecated or driver-layer overlap is intentionally outside the current managed ownership boundary.

rules.name: managed-next-hiprtc
rules.reason: HIPRTC linker, name-expression, or bitcode ownership is a planned independent 0.x batch.

rules.name: managed-next-virtual-memory
rules.reason: Virtual-memory reservation, mapping, access, and release require an explicit owner and capability workload.

rules.name: managed-next-array-texture-surface
rules.reason: Array, texture, or surface descriptors need a reviewed layout and resource-lifetime workload.

rules.name: managed-next-common-query
rules.reason: Common stream, event, device, or pointer queries are candidates after ownership and capability tests are added.

rules.name: raw-only-reviewed-default
rules.reason: Low-level binding is retained; no current managed owner or function-level cloud workload justifies promotion.
